title: A dispatched run on a lane branch waives the stale docs/records.md page, as a PR run does
why: A debt-retiring lane's Retire-run always ends red, so lint/check_debt_retire.py, which needs "success", can never retire a debt.
note: Coordinator 03:06 CST Nov 10; lane [ended:retire-run-records-waiver:-a-dispatched-run-waives] started 03:07 CST. A dispatched run on a lane branch does not waive the stale docs/records.md page as a PR run does, so the Retire-run ends red on lint/test_hook_catalog.py r10. Incident: notes-fix-page lane, #2024 run 42782146249 and #1969 run 42782509944; #2293 and #2311 blocked too.
